title: Build live source catalog and activity model
description:
Create SourceCatalog, the reactive model that combines PipeWireContext registry events with SourceDescriptor classification and PropertyNormalizer metadata to maintain a live, thread-safe catalog of capturable audio sources.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/pipewire/PipeWireContext.hpp for the globalAdded/globalRemoved callback signatures and GlobalObject struct
- src/pipewire/SourceDescriptor.hpp for SourceDescriptor, SourceCategory, and classifyMediaClass
- src/pipewire/PropertyNormalizer.hpp for extractDisplayName, extractAppName, extractMediaClass, extractDeviceId

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation:
1. SourceCatalog.hpp — declare SourceCatalog that depends on PipeWireContext. It owns a std::vector<SourceDescriptor> (or map keyed by nodeId) representing the current live sources. Expose: const std::vector<SourceDescriptor>& sources() const; std::optional<SourceDescriptor> sourceById(uint32_t id) const; void start(PipeWireContext& ctx); void stop(). Declare callbacks/signals for sourceAppeared(const SourceDescriptor&), sourceDisappeared(uint32_t nodeId), and catalogReset(). Declare a mutex for thread-safe access since PipeWireContext callbacks arrive on the PipeWire thread.
2. SourceCatalog.cpp — implement start() by registering as a listener on PipeWireContext's globalAdded/globalRemoved. In the globalAdded handler: extract media.class via PropertyNormalizer, classify via classifyMediaClass, and if isCapturableSource is true, build a SourceDescriptor using PropertyNormalizer extractors, insert into the catalog under lock, and emit sourceAppeared. In globalRemoved: remove by nodeId under lock and emit sourceDisappeared. stop() unregisters and clears the catalog. Handle rapid add/remove by checking existence before insert/remove.

Constraints:
- Thread safety: all catalog mutations must be guarded by std::mutex; do not hold the mutex while emitting signals.
- Do not perform file I/O or blocking operations in any callback path.
- Do not duplicate classification or normalization logic already in SourceDescriptor or PropertyNormalizer; call those modules.
- Filter non-audio and non-capturable nodes at insertion time, not at query time.
acceptance_criteria: src/pipewire/SourceCatalog.hpp declares SourceCatalog with sources(), sourceById(), start(PipeWireContext&), stop(), and sourceAppeared/sourceDisappeared callbacks
src/pipewire/SourceCatalog.cpp implements globalAdded handling that uses PropertyNormalizer and classifyMediaClass to build and insert SourceDescriptors
src/pipewire/SourceCatalog.cpp implements globalRemoved handling that removes entries by nodeId and emits sourceDisappeared
SourceCatalog uses std::mutex to guard catalog mutations and does not hold the lock while emitting signals
SourceCatalog includes PipeWireContext.hpp, SourceDescriptor.hpp, and PropertyNormalizer.hpp and delegates classification/normalization to those modules
g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only -I/usr/include/pipewire-0.3 -I/usr/include/spa-0.2 src/pipewire/SourceCatalog.hpp succeeds or the file is parseable as valid C++20 with required headers
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify PipeWireContext, SourceDescriptor, or PropertyNormalizer files
duplicate classification or normalization logic from other b-phase modules
add file I/O or blocking calls in callback paths

allowed: choose std::vector vs std::unordered_map for internal source storage
choose std::function callbacks vs Qt signals for catalog notifications
choose copy-then-emit vs emit-under-lock for signal thread safety
forbidden: introduce a Qt model or QAbstractListModel in this task
